name: Stablezact Crypto Payments for WooCommerce
author: stablezact

sections.description:
Stablezact is an entirely new payment infrastructure, built with blockchain technology, designed to simplify global crypto transactions for your WooCommerce store. Stablezact is a product of Stablezact FINTECH LTD.

Benefits for Merchants

  • Low Transaction Fees: Save up to 80% compared to traditional payment processors.
  • Instant Settlements: No more waiting days for funds to clear.
  • No Chargebacks: Eliminate fraud risk with irreversible transactions.
  • Global Accessibility: Accept payments from anywhere in the world.
  • Simplified Integration: Easy setup with your WooCommerce store.

Key Features

  • Seamless Checkout Experience: Customers pay with stablecoins from any of 300+ supported wallets.
  • Pay From Any Chain: Built-in bridging accepts payment from 60+ blockchain networks and settles to you automatically.
  • Real-time Exchange Rates: Order totals are converted at current market rates.
  • Non-Custodial Settlement: Payments go directly to your own wallet addresses.
  • Detailed Transaction Reports: Track all your payments in one place.
  • Responsive Design: Works on all devices and screen sizes.
  • Developer Friendly: Well-documented API for custom integrations.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Stablezact payment service (https://hub.stablezact.com), which is required for it to function as a payment gateway.

When a customer chooses to pay with Stablezact, the plugin sends the order amount, currency, an order reference, and your merchant public key to create and verify the payment. It also retrieves current exchange rates from the same service. No customer card details are ever handled, and no data is sent unless the customer selects this payment method. During payment, the customer’s own wallet software connects to its blockchain network to complete the transaction.

The service is operated by Stablezact FINTECH LTD. By using this plugin you agree to Stablezact’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:
Terms of Service: https://stablezact.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://stablezact.com/privacy

Support

For support, please visit Stablezact Support.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard > Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “Stablezact Crypto Payments for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  5. Find “Cryptocurrency Payment (Stablezact)” and click “Manage”.
  6. Enter your API credentials and configure the settings.
  7. Click “Save changes”.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress Dashboard > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click “Install Now”.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  6. Find “Cryptocurrency Payment (Stablezact)” and click “Manage”.
  7. Enter your API credentials and configure the settings.
  8. Click “Save changes”.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Stablezact account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need to create an account at Stablezact.com to get your API credentials.

Which cryptocurrencies are supported?

Stablezact supports stablecoin payments (such as USDT and USDC). Funds settle to your wallets on major networks including Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche, Base and Solana.

Customers are not limited to those networks. Built-in bridging lets them pay from 60+ blockchain networks using any of 300+ supported wallets, and the funds are converted and settled to you automatically. The full list of supported networks and tokens is available in your Stablezact dashboard.

How do I receive my funds?

Payments are settled in stablecoins directly to your own wallet addresses — Stablezact is non-custodial and never holds your funds.

Is there a transaction fee?

Stablezact charges a small fee per transaction, which is significantly lower than traditional payment processors. Current rates are shown in your Stablezact dashboard.

Is this plugin secure?

Yes, the plugin uses industry-standard security practices and all transactions are processed on the blockchain, ensuring high levels of security.
sections.changelog:
1.1.9

  • Fixed: the gateway settings could not be saved while enabling the gateway. The Public Key was discarded on save, so first-time setup could never be completed.
  • Fixed: settings are no longer discarded when the gateway cannot be enabled. Your Public Key is kept, and the gateway simply stays switched off with an explanation.
  • Fixed: the setup message about wallet addresses displayed raw HTML instead of readable text.
  • Fixed: the fee rate shown in the settings and on the Stablezact dashboard could display 1.75% instead of your actual rate of 1%.
  • Fixed: “Fee Charged To” could read “Customer”, suggesting customers pay a surcharge. The fee is always deducted from your payout and never added to what the customer pays.
  • Changed: “Fee Charged To” and “Current Fee Percentage” are now read-only. Both are set by Stablezact.
  • Changed: the support link on the setup screen now points to the Stablezact contact page.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1.

1.1.8

  • Initial release on WordPress.org.
